Shadowborn.desc: "You have a keen vision in the darkness of the night." Whenever you are blinded by any means, Shadowborn triggers its effect: Grants a 6 / 8 / 10 % Haste Status Effect for 10 seconds . "Shining in the darkest dark, his eyes pierce the night and sting your soul."

Shattered Hope.desc: To capture your prey, you must first extinguish their hope. Instead of snuffing Boon Totems you destroy them. Whenever a Totem is blessed, cleansed or destroyed: All Totems are blocked for 16 / 18 / 20 seconds . All blessed Totem auras are revealed to you for 16 / 18 / 20 seconds . "Nothing is permanent here. Nothing except our endless perdition." — Unknown, Notebook Trivia [ edit ] Boon Totems that were destroyed with Shattered Hope can be immediately rekindled with Hex: Pentimento . Shattered Hope's secondary effect is temporarily blocked if it is used to destroy Boon: Shadow Step , as Shadow Step has a linger effect on its Aura-blocking. Shattered Hope's secondary effect will activate for the remainder of its duration once the linger effect has elapsed. In the game files, Shattered Hope is called "Boon Destroyer" .

Shoulder the Burden.desc: "Born to be a disciple. Ready to submit to a greater cause. This is your calling." Once per Trial, and while you are not on Death Hook , press the Active Ability button while standing in front of a Hooked Survivor to unhook them and trigger the following effects: Trade 1 Hook Stage with the other Survivor to their benefit. Causes you to scream, become injured if healthy and suffer from the Broken Status Effect for 160 / 140 / 120 seconds . "It's not your time yet. Now go on!" — Taurie Cain

Slippery Meat.desc: You have developed an efficient way to get off Hooks. Other Survivors unhook you 65 / 70 / 75 % faster. Increases the Haste granted by Unhook Protections by +7 % .

Sloppy Butcher.desc: "You know where to hit to make them bleed." Survivors hit with your vicious Basic Attack suffer from the following effects for 70 / 80 / 90 seconds : Inflicts the Haemorrhage and Mangled Status Effects . Modifies the potency of Haemorrhage : Increases the Spawn frequency of Pools of Blood by 50 / 75 / 100 % . Increases the Regression rate of partial Healing progression by +25 % . "It is in its sadistic nature. There is no swift kill as it delights in the obscene spectacle of our agonising suffering."

Small Game.desc: "You have the undeniable capability to sense danger." You see auras of Totems within 10 / 11 / 12 metres . "Nope." — Andy, The Lost Tapes

Smash Hit.desc: "When your rival makes a mistake, you seize the opportunity." Whenever you stun the Killer with a Pallet , Smash Hit triggers its effect: Grants a +50 % Haste Status Effect for 4 seconds . Smash Hit cannot be used while Exhausted . Smash Hit causes the Exhausted Status Effect for 30 / 25 / 20 seconds . "I have dealt with psychopaths in suits. You're just uglier and worse dressed." — Yun-Jin Lee

Solidarity.desc: "Sharing painful experiences has the power to heal." While injured, healing another Survivor causes Solidarity to apply the following effects: Grants the ability to passively heal yourself while healing other Survivors. Reduces your Personal Healing speed to 65 / 70 / 75 % of your Altruistic Healing speed. "Showing up when things get rough, listening to people's problems, and supporting those in need; that's how you become stronger, that's how you grow." — Jane Romero

Soul Guard.desc: "You have been through immense hardship and you are stronger for it." Whenever you heal or recover from the Dying State , Soul Guard triggers its primary effect: Grants the Endurance Status Effect for 4 / 6 / 8 seconds . Endurance is cancelled prematurely when performing a Conspicuous Action of any kind. This ability has a cool-down of 30 seconds . While suffering from the Cursed Status Effect , Soul Guard applies its secondary effect: Unlocks the Self-Recovery ability, allowing you to fully recover from the Dying State. .

Specialist.desc: Adventure. Exploration. Excavation. You are in your element. Whenever you unlock or rummage through a Chest , Specialist gains +1 Token , up to a maximum of 6 Tokens : Succeeding a Great Repair Skill Check while repairing a Generator consumes all Tokens. Permanently reduces the Repair Charges requirement of that Generator by 2 / 3 / 4 Charges per Token, up to a maximum of 12 / 18 / 24 Charges . "Well, then. Doesn't this feel familiar?" — Lara Croft Trivia [ edit ] Players can save Specialist for use at their discretion by purposefully only hitting Good Repair Skill Checks on Generators that they do not wish to activate it on. While the effect of Specialist is quite strong, its strength is balanced out by the fact that in order to reduce a Generator's Repair requirement by a substantial amount, the user first needs to spend a lot of time interacting with Chests , which is tim

Spies from the Shadows.desc: "Allows the Crows found in the environment to directly communicate with you." Whenever a Survivor startles a Crow within 36 / 38 / 40 metres of your location, Spies from the Shadows triggers its effect: Alerts you with a unique Loud Noise Notification in the shape of a Crow . Spies from the Shadows has a cool-down of 3 seconds between alerts. "In the shadows they torment, scarring our minds with each scream."

Spine Chill.desc: An unnatural tingle warns you of impending doom. Whenever the Killer is within 40 metres of your location and is looking at you, Spine Chill activates: You are notified. You cannot scream for 12 seconds . You vault +10 % faster for 12 seconds . Spine Chill then goes on a 40 / 35 / 30 seconds cool-down. "There is a voice that doesn't use words. Listen.." — Sassy, The Lost Tapes

Spirit Fury.desc: "Each obstacle you break magnifies the wrath of The Entity." After manually breaking a total of 4 / 3 / 2 dropped Pallets by any means, Spirit Fury activates: Instantly breaks the next Pallet used by a Survivor to stun you. Spirit Fury deactivates after use and does not affect the duration of the Pallet Stun . "Fury is her blood." History [ edit ] 2.2.0 (PTB) Icon Description After manually breaking a total of 4 / 3 / 2 dropped Pallets by any means, Spirit Fury activates: Instantly breaks the next Pallet used by a Survivor to stun you. Spirit Fury deactivates after use and does not affect the duration of the Pallet Stun . Sprint Burst.desc: Starting to run triggers Sprint Burst : Grants a +50 % Haste Status Effect for 2 seconds . Sprint Burst cannot be used while Exhausted . Sprint Burst causes the Exhausted Status Effect for 60 / 50 / 40 seconds . "See you if you can catch up..." — Meg Thomas

Stake Out.desc: "Getting close to the Killer fills you with determination." Staying in the Terror Radius and within 24 metres of the Killer without being chased grants +1 Token every 15 seconds , up to a maximum of 2 / 3 / 4 Tokens . While performing a skilful interaction that can trigger Skill Checks , you benefit from the following effects: Replaces regular Skill Checks with special Skill Checks. These Skill Checks grant +4 % more progress on success. Succeeding or missing a special Skill Check consumes -1 Token . "I had you, I had you on your knees. You're runnin' scared because we had you. We're gonna close this case!" — Detective David Tapp

Starstruck.desc: "Your unmatched showmanship dazzles all." Whenever you are carrying a Survivor, Starstruck activates: Causes all other Survivors in your Terror Radius to suffer from the Exposed Status Effect . This effect lingers for 26 / 28 / 30 seconds after affected Survivors leave the Terror Radius or Starstruck deactivates. Starstruck deactivates after hooking or dropping the carried Survivor and has a cool-down of 60 seconds . "Enjoy this moment, few get so close." — Ji-Woon Hak History [ edit ] 4.6.0 4.6.0 (PTB) Icon Description Whenever you are carrying a Survivor, Starstruck activates: Causes all other Survivors in your Terror Radius to suffer from the Exposed Status Effect . This effect lingers for 26 / 28 / 30 seconds after affected Survivors leave the Terror Radius or Starstruck deactivates. Still Sight.desc: "A clear mind and calm temperament will always find the means of their escape." After standing still for 4 / 3 / 2 seconds , Still Sight activates: The following Auras are revealed to you within 24 meters : Killer Chests Generators Still Sight deactivates once you start moving again. "Breathe in. Breathe out. Now open your eyes." — Baermar

Streetwise.desc: "Long nights out taught you to do a lot with what you have got." Any Items with Charges you retrieve from Chests benefit from the following primary effect: Increases their Charges permanently by 60 / 70 / 80 % . Whenever your currently equipped Item is depleted for the first time , Streetwise triggers its secondary effect: The Aura of the Killer is revealed to you for 8 seconds . "You are doing it wrong! Let me show you how it is done." — Nea Karlsson

Strength in Shadows.desc: "A chance for renewed power down where danger calls home." Whenever you are inside the Basement , Strength in Shadows activates: Unlocks the Strength in Shadows ability, allowing you to self-heal without needing a Med-Kit at 70 % of the normal Healing speed. Upon finishing a heal in the Basement, the Aura of the Killer is revealed to you for 6 / 8 / 10 seconds . "I'm getting out of here, if it's the last thing I do." — Sable

Stridor.desc: You are acutely sensitive to the breathing of your prey. Increases the volume of Grunts of Pain of injured Survivors by 30 / 40 / 50 % . Increases the volume of regular breathing of Survivors by 15 / 20 / 25 % . "If you do not stop and catch your breath... she will."

Superior Anatomy.desc: "Decades of research have culminated in you: something faster, stronger, and more dangerous than any human." Whenever a Survivor performs a Rush Vault action within 12 metres of your location, Superior Anatomy activates for 10 seconds : Increases your Vaulting speed by 30 / 35 / 40 % . Superior Anatomy has a cool-down of 20 seconds .

Surge.desc: "Your eerie presence charges the air and interferes with technology." Whenever you put a Survivor into the Dying State with your Basic Attack , Surge triggers its effect: Causes all Generators within 32 metres of your location to instantly explode and start regressing. Instantly regresses all affected Generators by 6 / 7 / 8 % . "The creature appears to have some unknown influence over electricity and nearby electronics." — Hawkins National Laboratory

Surveillance.desc: Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability: The Auras of damaged Generators are highlighted based on their current state: White Aura : The Generator is currently regressing. Yellow Aura : The Generator stopped regressing due to Survivor-intervention. This effect lasts for 8 / 12 / 16 seconds , after which the Generator Aura returns to its default colour. While Survivors are repairing Generators , they suffer from the following effect: Increases the audible range of all noises related to the Repair interaction by +8 metres . "Are you gonna behave?" — Amanda Young

Teamwork: Collective Stealth.desc: "When someone helps you out, you respond in kind." Whenever another Survivor finishes healing you, Teamwork: Collective Stealth activates, and both you and the Survivor who healed you benefit from the following effect: Suppresses your Scratch Marks for as long as you stay within 8 / 12 / 16 metres of one another. This effect lingers for 4 seconds once out of range and resumes upon re-entering it before that timer elapses. Survivors can only be affected by one instance of Teamwork: Collective Stealth at a time. "I'm good, I'm good... but keep it down." — Renato Lyra History [ edit ] 8.3.0 6.6.0 Icon Description When someone helps you out, you respond in kind. Whenever another Survivor finishes healing you, Teamwork: Collective Stealth activates, and both you and the Survivor who healed you benefit from the following effect: Suppresses your Scratch Marks for as long as you sta

Teamwork: Full Circuit.desc: "You've dabbled with mechanical engineering and show off your abilities to others." For each Survivor repairing a generator with you, the size of the good Skill Check zone is increased by 15 / 20 / 25 % . While repairing with at least 1 other Survivor , you repair 5 % faster. "How many times do I have to be right on the money before you guys just trust me?" — Dustin Henderson History [ edit ]

Teamwork: Power of Two.desc: "It is hard to keep up with you, but it does not stop people from trying." Whenever you finish healing another Survivor, Teamwork: Power of Two activates, and both you and the healed Survivor benefit from the following effect: Grants a +5 % Haste Status Effect for as long as you stay within 8 / 12 / 16 metres of one another. This effect lingers for 4 seconds once out of range and resumes upon re-entering it before that timer elapses. Survivors can only be affected by one instance of Teamwork: Power of Two at a time. "You good? Then keep up!" — Thalita Lyra History [ edit ] 8.3.0 6.6.0 Icon Description It is hard to keep up with you, but it does not stop people from trying. Teamwork: Soft-Spoken.desc: "You look out for your friends, using your abilities to protect them." For each other Survivor repairing a Generator with you, the range at which the Generator 's repair noise is heard is reduced by 15 / 20 / 25 % . While repairing with at least 1 other Survivor , you repair 5 % faster. "I make my own rules." — Eleven History [ edit ]

Teamwork: Throw Down.desc: "You know the best way to even the odds is to empower those around you." Whenever you blind the Killer by any means or stun them using a Pallet , Teamwork: Throw Down triggers its effect: Grants the Endurance Status Effect to all other injured Survivors within 24 metres of your location for 6 / 8 / 10 seconds . "Facing evil brings good people together." — Michonne Grimes History [ edit ] 9.1.0 (PTB) Icon Description Whenever you blind the Killer by any means or stun them using a Pallet , Teamwork: Throw Down triggers its effect: Grants the Endurance Status Effect to all other injured Survivors within 24 metres of your location for 6 / 8 / 10 seconds . Trivia [ edit ] None

Teamwork: Toughen Up.desc: "You maintain your composure under immense amounts of pain." While injured, whenever another Survivor within 24 metres of your location blinds the Killer by any means or stuns them using a Pallet , Teamwork: Toughen Up triggers its effect: Suppresses your Grunts of Pain , and the creation of Pools of Blood and Scratch Marks for 20 / 25 / 30 seconds . "They're fucking with the wrong people." — Rick Grimes History [ edit ] 9.1.0 (PTB) Icon Description While injured, whenever another Survivor within 24 metres of your location blinds the Killer by any means or stuns them using a Pallet , Teamwork: Toughen Up triggers its effect: Suppresses your Grunts of Pain , and the creation of Pools of Blood and Scratch Marks for 20 / 25 / 30 seconds . Trivia [ edit ] Flavor text is a direct quote from The Walking Dead's Season 4 Episode 16 uncensored ending.

Technician.desc: "You are apt at handling machinery with the greatest care and precision." While repairing a Generator , the following effects apply: Reduces the audible range of all noises related to the Repair interaction by -16 metres . Increases the Progression penalty incurred when failing a Skill Check by 4 / 3 / 2 % . Suppresses the explosion of the Generator and the Loud Noise Notification usually triggered by that. "I am gonna stealth this one." — Feng Min

Tenacity.desc: "There is nothing stopping you." Your ferocious tenacity in dire situations allows you to benefit from the following effects while in the Dying State : Grants the ability to recover while crawling. Grants a 30 / 40 / 50 % Haste Status Effect . Reduces the volume of Grunts of Pain by -75 % . Blocks your Aura from being read. "What the hell is this? I'm taking this bastard down!" — Detective David Tapp

Terminus.desc: "You are a brilliant tactician who prepares for every eventuality." Once the Exit Gates are powered, Terminus activates: Causes all injured, dying, or hooked Survivors to suffer from the Broken Status Effect . This effect last until one of the Exit Gates is opened, after which it lingers for another 35 / 40 / 45 seconds .

Territorial Imperative.desc: Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability. Whenever a Survivor enters the Basement while you are farther than 24 metres from its entrance, Territorial Imperative activates: The Aura of that Survivor is revealed to you for 4 / 5 / 6 seconds . Territorial Imperative has a cool-down of 45 seconds . "We're not safe anywhere..."

Thanatophobia.desc: "Their courage fades in the face of their undeniable mortality." Whenever at least one Survivor is either injured, dying, or hooked, Thanatophobia activates. While active, all Survivors suffer from the following primary effect: Incurs a stack-able 1 / 1.5 / 2 % Action-Speed penalty per injured, dying, or hooked Survivor for Cleansing, Repairing, and Sabotaging, up to a maximum of 4 / 6 / 8 % . If all four Survivors are either injured, dying, or hooked, they suffer from the following secondary effect: Increases the penalty by an additional +12 % to a total of 16 / 18 / 20 % . "She plays with us and revels in our pain."

This Is Not Happening.desc: "You perform at your best when you are under extreme stress." While repairing or healing, This Is Not Happening activates: Increases the Success zone for a Good Skill Check by 150 / 175 / 200 % .

Thrilling Tremors.desc: "Your dark designs and shrewd composure rouse The Entity ." After picking up a Survivor, Thrilling Tremors triggers its effects: Blocks all Generators not currently being repaired by any Survivors for 16 seconds . The Auras of Blocked Generators are highlighted to you in white . Thrilling Tremors has a cool-down of 40 / 35 / 30 seconds . "The night assists me and it's endless here." — The Ghost Face

THWACK!.desc: "Your prey is terrified by your relentless pursuit." Start the Trial with 3 Tokens . Whenever you break a Breakable Wall or a dropped Pallet , THWACK! consumes -1 Token and applies the following effect: Causes all Survivors within 36 metres of your location to scream and reveal their Aura for 4 / 5 / 6 seconds . Whenever you hook a Survivor, THWACK! is granted +1 Token . "All those who stood in her path feared her mighty THWACK!" — Sonhadores Sombrios, Issue #3

Tinkerer.desc: Whenever a Generator is repaired to 70 % , you benefit from the following effects: Triggers a Loud Noise Notification for that Generator, revealing its location. Grants the Undetectable Status Effect for the next 12 / 14 / 16 seconds . Tinkerer can only trigger once per Generator per Trial. "The Hillbilly makes impressive tools out of scraps. Tools aimed at maiming us in creative ways." — Notebook

Tough Runner.desc: THIS PERK IS UNUSED ( This Unlockable is not used in the current Game, but exists in the Game Code. ) THIS PERK WAS UNUSED AND UNOBTAINABLE BY PLAYERS. THE EFFECTS OF THIS PERK ARE UNKNOWN.

Trail of Torment.desc: "You guide your victims along a path of pain and punishment." Performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator activates Trail of Torment : Grants the Undetectable Status Effect . The Aura of the Damaged Generator is revealed to all Survivors and highlighted in yellow . Trail of Torment deactivates after the Damaged Generator stops regressing by any means and has a cool-down of 60 / 45 / 30 seconds between activations.

Troubleshooter.desc: "No amount of distraction will shake you from your primary task." When you are chased by the Killer, Troubleshooter activates: The Aura of the Generator with the most progress is revealed to you. The Aura of the Killer is revealed to you for 4 / 5 / 6 seconds after dropping a Pallet . These effects linger for 6 / 8 / 10 seconds after ending the Chase, after which Troubleshooter deactivates. "Nothing gets done around here if I don't do it." — Gabriel Soma

Turn Back the Clock.desc: "Resist as they might, time marches on, and your master plan comes closer to fruition." After hooking a Survivor, for 40 / 50 / 60 seconds , press the Active Ability button to make a target generator within 20 meters explode, lose -10 % progress, and start regressing. "Nothing will happen to you... Nothing that you don't deserve!" — Henry Creel History [ edit ]

Unbound.desc: "Pain lingers in the air, an alluring aroma that excites the impulses." When a Survivor becomes injured by any means, Unbound activates for 26 / 28 / 30 seconds : Vaulting a Window while Unbound is active grants a +5 % Haste Status Effect for 25 seconds . This effect cannot stack with itself. "I heard it. Running. It was getting closer!" — Anonymous Testimony, 09/09/1979

Underperform.desc: THIS PERK IS UNUSED ( This Unlockable is not used in the current Game, but exists in the Game Code. ) THIS PERK WAS UNUSED AND UNOBTAINABLE BY PLAYERS. THE EFFECTS OF THIS PERK ARE UNKNOWN. Trivia [ edit ] Underperform is an unused Perk associated with the equally unused Killer The Teacher . The icon portrays a Survivor wearing a "dunce cap".

Undone.desc: "Hope is the delusion that keeps its victims alive." For every time you hook a Survivor, Undone gains +1 Token , up to a maximum of 1 / 2 / 3 Token(s) . Performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator consumes all accumulated Tokens and applies the following effects: Instantly regresses the Damaged Generator by a stack-able -10 % of its total Progression per Token, up to a maximum of 10 / 20 / 30 % . Blocks the Damaged Generator for 10 seconds per Token, up to a maximum of 10 / 20 / 30 seconds . Causes the Damaged Generator to start regressing once it becomes unblocked. "Erratic behavior in machinery could be related to [REDACTED], further testing required." — OSS Report, 12/02/1943 History [ edit ] 10.2.0 7.6.0 (PTB) Icon Description For every time you hook a Survivor, Undone gains +1 Token , up to a maximum of 1 / 2 / 3 Tokens . Performing the Damage Generator action

Unforeseen.desc: "Terror takes many forms and whispers devastating lies in its victims' ears." After performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator , you benefit from the following effects for 22 / 26 / 30 seconds : Transfers your Terror Radius to the damaged Generator . This Terror Radius is set to 32 metres . Grants the Undetectable Status Effect . Unforeseen has a cool-down of 30 seconds . "Mom, if you find this, I'm sorry..." — Final Journal Entry, 07/12/1991 History [ edit ] 7.6.0 (PTB) Icon Description After performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator , you benefit from the following effects for 22 / 26 / 30 seconds : Transfers your Terror Radius to the damaged Generator . This Terror Radius is set to 32 metres . Grants the Undetectable Status Effect . Unforeseen has a cool-down of 30 seconds . Trivia [ edit ] Since Unforeseen transfers the Killer's Terror Radius to a

Ultimate Weapon.desc: "When they spot you, they know the end is near." Whenever you search a Locker , Ultimate Weapon triggers its effects on all Survivors within 40 metres of its location: Causes them to scream and reveal their location to you. Inflicts the Blindness Status Effect for 30 seconds . Ultimate Weapon has a cool-down of 55 / 50 / 45 seconds . "I can't lie to you about your chances, but... you have my sympathies." — Ash

Unnerving Presence.desc: "Your presence alone instils great fear." While inside your Terror Radius , Survivors performing Repairing or Healing actions suffer from the following effects: Increases the chances of triggering a Skill Check by +10 % . Reduces the Success zone of those Skill Checks by 40 / 50 / 60 % . "Its presence befalls us."

Unbreakable.desc: "Past battles have taught you a thing or two about survival." Whenever you are put in the Dying State by the Killer, Unbreakable activates: Increases your Recovery speed by 25 / 30 / 35 % . Unlocks the Self-Recovery ability, allowing you to fully recover from the Dying State . This ability can only be used once per Trial. "Goddammit, I am seriously FUBAR!" — Bill Overbeck

Unrelenting.desc: "You recuperate faster from missed attacks made with your main weapon." Basic Attacks benefit from the following effect: Increases the recovery speed of missed basic-attacks by 30 / 35 / 40 % . Increases the recovery speed of successful basic-attacks by 10 % .

Up the Ante.desc: "All will be well in the end; you just know it. Your confidence strengthens the feeling of hope for those around you." Unlocks the ability to attempt Self-Unhooks during the first Hook Stage for all Survivors. For every Survivor still in the Trial, Up the Ante is granted +1 Token : Increases the Luck at succeeding Self-Unhook attempts for all Survivors by a stack-able 1 / 2 / 3 % per Token, up to a maximum of 3 / 6 / 9 % . "What can I say? I'm just a very lucky guy... I'm sure some of it will rub off on you." — Ace Visconti

Urban Evasion.desc: "Years of evading the cops taught you a thing or two about stealth." You benefit from the following permanent effect: Increases your Movement speed while crouched by 90 / 95 / 100 % . "The paint is still fresh but I am long gone." — Nea Karlsson

Vigil.desc: "You watch over your friends, even in dire situations." You recover 20 / 25 / 30 % faster from the following: The Exhausted Status Effect . Vigil extends its effect to all Survivors within 16 metres of your location and lingers for 15 seconds after leaving its Area of Effect . Survivors can only be affected by one instance of Vigil at a time. "I am gonna be here when you wake up. You are gonna make it." — Quentin Smith

Visionary.desc: "You are remarkably focused on your means of escape." You benefit from the following permanent effect: The Auras of Generators are revealed to you within 32 metres . Visionary is temporarily deactivated for 20 / 18 / 16 seconds whenever a Generator is completed. Trivia [ edit ] You can extend Visionary's range by using the Perk Open-Handed . Visionary still shows an Aura for Generators blocked by The Entity . Déjà Vu does not boost repair speed to generators revealed by Visionary . Video [ edit ] Visionary revealing Generator Auras Visionary being temporarily disabled when a Generator is completed Gallery [ edit ] Generator Auras revelead by Visionary Visionary revealing the Aura of a Generator blocked by The Entity

Wake Up!.desc: Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability. Once all Generators are completed, Wake Up! activates: The Auras of the Exit Gate Switches are revealed to you permanently while within 128 metres . Your Aura is revealed to all other Survivors within 128 metres while you are opening an Exit Gate . Increases your Gate-Opening speed by 8 / 9 / 10 % and by an additional #effect for each Survivor still alive in the Trial up to a maximum of 68 / 69 / 70 % . "Ok, look. If we survive the next 24 hours, then I'll take you out on a real date." — Quentin Smith

Wandering Eye.desc: "Bloodied prey surrounds you, vying for your attention." Whenever you start chasing a Survivor, Wandering Eye triggers the following effect: The Auras of all other injured Survivors within 20 metres of your location are revealed to you for 5 seconds . Wandering Eye has a cool-down of 40 / 35 / 30 seconds . "A drop does not satiate/when a river is needed." — Elliot Campbell's "Grandeur of Samuel" History [ edit ] 9.2.0 9.2.0 (PTB) Icon Description Whenever you start chasing a Survivor, Wandering Eye triggers the following effect: The Auras of all other injured Survivors within 20 metres of your location are revealed to you for 5 seconds . Wandering Eye has a cool-down of 40 / 35 / 30 seconds . Icon Description Whenever you start chasing a Survivor, Wandering Eye triggers the following effect: The Auras of all other injured Survivors within 16 metres of your location are revea

We See You.desc: "You've honed your powers and can turn the tables on those who try to find you." Gain a token when the Killer reveals your Aura . When you have 4 tokens , they are all consumed, and the Killer 's aura is revealed to you and all other Survivors for 10 / 12.5 / 15 seconds . This perk has a 10-second cool-down when gaining a token. "It is not me. It is you. You are the monster." — Eleven History [ edit ]

We'll Make It.desc: "Helping others heightens your morale." After unhooking another Survivor, We'll Make It activates for 70 / 80 / 90 seconds : Increases your Altruistic Healing speed by +100 % . "I am confident we can all escape in one piece if we help each other."

We're Gonna Live Forever.desc: Your few friends deserve the best protection. You benefit from the following effect when healing a dying Survivor: Increases your Healing speed by +100 % . Any dying Survivor you heal back to the Injured State benefits from the following effect: Grants the Endurance Status Effect for 6 / 8 / 10 seconds . This effect can only be triggered once every 30 seconds . "Come on then, let's ave' it! I don't give a shit pal." — David King

Weave Attunement.desc: "You are so attuned to magical energies that you can sense even minor ripples around enchantments." Whenever an Item is depleted for the first time, it is automatically dropped: The Auras of dropped Survivor Items are revealed to you, as well as the Auras of any Survivors within 12 metres of them. Affected Survivors see the Aura of that Item as well. Causes Survivors picking up a Survivor Item to suffer from the Oblivious Status Effect for 20 / 25 / 30 seconds . "No number of novelties will protect you from me!" — Vecna

Whispers.desc: "You have a rudimentary understanding of The Entity's voice." Whenever any Survivor is within 28 / 26 / 24 metres of your location: Causes you to hear the sporadic whispers of The Entity , indicating a Survivor's presence. Whenever any Survivor is outside 28 / 26 / 24 metres of your location: Gain +7 % Haste Status Effect . "It is unclear as to the motivations of The Fog, but it is undeniable that it often takes the beast's side." — Unknown, Notebook

Wicked.desc: "They can try to hurt you. But you're not going down so easily." After you are unhooked by any means, Wicked triggers the following effect: The Aura of the Killer is revealed to you for 16 / 18 / 20 seconds . While hooked inside the Basement , Wicked potentially triggers the following effect: First Hook Stage : 100 % to succeed an attempted Self-Unhook . Second Hook Stage : Does not trigger the effect. Last Survivor Standing : Does not trigger the effect. "I haven't let anyone get in my way before. You think I'm gonna start now?" — Sable

Will to Live.desc: Using whatever is at hand, you stab your aggressor in an ultimate attempt to escape. After being unhooked or unhooking yourself, Will to Live activates for the next 40 / 50 / 60 seconds : When grabbed or picked up by the Killer, succeed a Skill Check to stab the Killer and escape from their grasp. Stuns the Killer for 4 seconds . Causes you to become the next Obsession . Will to Live is deactivated once the Exit Gates are powered. Will to Live is disabled for the remainder of the Trial after use. Will to Live is deactivated prematurely when performing a Conspicuous Action . Increases your chance of becoming the initial Obsession by increasing the default value by +100 % . The Killer can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.

Decisive Strike.desc: Using whatever is at hand, you stab your aggressor in an ultimate attempt to escape. After being unhooked or unhooking yourself, Will to Live activates for the next 40 / 50 / 60 seconds : When grabbed or picked up by the Killer, succeed a Skill Check to stab the Killer and escape from their grasp. Stuns the Killer for 4 seconds . Causes you to become the next Obsession . Will to Live is deactivated once the Exit Gates are powered. Will to Live is disabled for the remainder of the Trial after use. Will to Live is deactivated prematurely when performing a Conspicuous Action . Increases your chance of becoming the initial Obsession by increasing the default value by +100 % . The Killer can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.

Windows of Opportunity.desc: Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability. The Auras of Windows are revealed to you within 24 metres . You vault Windows +10 % faster. Windows of Opportunity goes on a 40 / 35 / 30 seconds cool-down when you vault a Window . "Rise and shine, work hard, carve out your name, Take aim, pull the trigger, hit the bulls eye for fame, Know the value of faith, an' family, and don't you complain, Open wide, your windows of opportunity" — Kate Denson's "Windows of Opportunity"

Wiretap.desc: "You know that the best way to stay one step ahead is to keep tabs on the competition." After repairing a Generator for the equivalent of 40 % of Progression, Wiretap activates. While active, press the Active Ability button while standing next to a Generator to install a listening device to it with a countdown of 100 / 110 / 120 seconds : Reveals the Aura of the Killer coming within 14 metres of the Bugged Generator to all Survivors. The listening device is deactivated after its countdown has elapsed or the Bugged Generator is damaged. The Auras of Bugged Generators are revealed to all Survivors in yellow .

Zanshin Tactics.desc: "You are mentally alert and aware of key points on the battlefield and nearby enemies in retreat." Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability: The Auras of Pallets and Windows are revealed to you within 32 metres . Whenever a Survivor drops a Pallet , Zanshin Tactics triggers the following effect: Their Aura is revealed to you for 3 / 4 / 5 seconds . "Within your enemy's strength is weakness." — Renjiro's Doctrine 12:5

Hex: Scared to Death.desc: When you Hook 3 different Survivors, Hex: Scared to Death activates on a random Dull Totem and triggers its effect: Basic-breaking a Pallet during a chase causes all Survivors within 13 metres to scream and gain -11 / -12 / -13 % Hindered Status Effect for 3 seconds . The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial. "There was a scream from the forest. Like someone was attacking her." — Mount Ormond Missing Person Report History [ edit ]

Silent Shadow.desc: When you hook a Survivor, you are granted Undetectable Status Effect for 11 / 12 / 13 seconds . When the Exit Gates are powered, you are granted Undetectable for the rest of the Trial. "Did you see him or not? I can't put out an APB for a bad feeling." — Sgt. Reyes, Greenville Police History [ edit ] 10.0.0 10.0.0 PTB Icon Description When you hook a Survivor, you are granted Undetectable Status Effect for 11 / 12 / 13 seconds . When the Exit Gates are powered, you are granted Undetectable for the rest of the Trial. Icon Description At the start of the Trial, you are granted Undetectable Status Effect for 11 / 12 / 13 seconds . When the Exit Gates are powered, you are granted Undetectable for the rest of the Trial. Change Log [ edit ] Patch 10.0.0 [ edit ] Rework : Undetectable is now granted when hooking Survivors instead of at the start of the Trial.

Rampage.desc: Whenever you basic-break a Pallet or a Breakable Wall , gain a token, up to 13 . Whenever you are blinded or Pallet-stunned, you are granted +1 % Haste Status Effect for each Token this perk has for 13 seconds . This perk has a cool-down of 30 / 25 / 20 seconds after being blinded or Pallet-stunned while this perk has at least 1 token. "Signs of a pursuit led deep into the woods where the victim's body was found." — Port Henly Herald History [ edit ]

Wide Open Throttle.desc: Fast-vaulting a Pallet triggers the following effects: Gain 10 / 12.5 / 15 % Haste Status Effect for 3 seconds . The Pallet is immediately reset, blocked by the Entity and revealed to all Survivors for 60 seconds . This perk then goes on a 60 second cool-down. "Nothing but the open road. Just the way I like it." — Shane Wiigwaas History [ edit ] 10.0.0 10.0.0 PTB Icon Description Fast-vaulting a Pallet triggers the following effects: Gain 10 / 12.5 / 15 % Haste Status Effect for 3 seconds . The Pallet is immediately reset, blocked by the Entity and revealed to all Survivors for 60 seconds . This perk then goes on a 60 seconds cool-down Identical to the previous version, except for the icon. Icon Description Fast-vaulting a Pallet triggers the following effects: Gain 10 / 12.5 / 15 % Haste Status Effect for 3 seconds . The Pallet is immediately reset, blocked by the Entity an

Lend a Hand.desc: Cleansing or Blessing a Totem activates Lend a Hand : Once per Survivor, while healing a Survivor, press Activate Ability 2 to give the healed Survivor 2 / 3 / 4 permanent healing charges. "Walk it off, will you? We still have work to do." — Shane Wiigwaas History [ edit ] 10.0.0 10.0.0 PTB Icon Description Cleansing or Blessing a Totem activates Lend a Hand Once per Survivor, while healing a Survivor, press Activate Ability 2 to give the healed Survivor 2 / 3 / 4 permanent healing charges Icon Description Cleansing or Blessing a Totem activates Lend a Hand Once per Trial and per Survivor, while healing a Survivor, press Activate Ability 2 to give the healed Survivor 2 / 3 / 4 permanent healing charges Change Log [ edit ] Patch 10.0.0 [ edit ] Buff : removed once per Trial downside.

Cross-Examination.desc: While inside the Killer's Terror Radius and not being chased, you can see Light Marks the Killer leaves behind while moving. Light Marks have a duration of 10 seconds . While standing on a Light Mark , gain Elusive Status Effect . This lingers for 3 / 4 / 5 seconds . "The witness has said enough, Your Honor. No further questions." — Shane Wiigwaas

Hex: Under Your Thumb.desc: When a Survivor gains a Hook State, Hex: Under Your Thumb activates on a random Dull Totem : Running Survivors cannot gain more than 25 / 20 / 15 % Haste at once. Whenever a running Survivor within 32 metres gains Haste , the Survivor's location is revealed to you for 4 seconds . The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial. "They will run, but Judgment will make the very ground they tread turn to ash and smoke." — (Visions of Gerhardt, ch. 1)

Celestial Witness.desc: Every 30 seconds , if the Obsession is 40 metres away from you, you see their aura for 2 / 2.5 / 3 seconds . Otherwise, the farthest Survivor becomes the Obsession . "And so the heretics huddled, cowardly, in the night; but upon Judgment’s arrival, It saw them all, and punished them." — (Witness to Koenrad, ch. 32) Trivia [ edit ] This Perk was originally called "Vigilance". The name change was likely done to avoid confusion with Vigil .

Lay Waste.desc: Damaging a Generator makes it regress +2 % faster for each Charge it has. This perk has a cool-down of 55 / 50 / 45 seconds after damaging a Generator . "They built hypercomputers and skyscrapers and quantum networks, but all of those things trembled and fell under the power of Judgment’s light." — (Witness to Koenrad, ch. 8)

Fruits of Your Labor.desc: Whenever a Generator is completed, gain a token. Whenever you finish repairing a Generator , for each token this perk has: Gain +5 % Haste Status Effect for 2 seconds . Gain 10 / 15 / 20 % healing progress. "And as the final brick was laid upon the walls of Stellanatis, the people rejoiced." — (Kelglen’s Declaration, 9:9)

Salvation's Cry.desc: When the Killer starts chasing you: You see the auras of other Survivors for 1 / 2 / 3 seconds . Survivors not being chased see your aura for 5 seconds Survivors not being chased see the Killer's aura for 5 seconds "May you see as the stars see." — (Auroran Blessing)

Boon: Steadfast.desc: Press and hold the Active Ability button on a Dull or Hex Totem to bless it and create a Boon Totem . All Survivors within 24 metres hear soft chimes ringing out and benefit from its Boon Effects : Generators within this Boon's range: Regress -50 % slower. Survivors repair them + 8 / 9 / 10 % faster. Survivors see their auras while inside the Boon's range. Survivors can only be affected by one instance of Boon: Steadfast at a time. Only one Totem can be blessed by your Boon Perks at a time and all of their effects are active on the same Boon Totem . "That which thine hands deliver shall prosper, for thine hands are guided by faith." — (Enlightenments, 2:10)

Laughingstock.desc: Survivors within 12 metres of a completed Generator suffer from: Exhausted and Oblivious Status Effects These effects linger for 3 / 4 / 5 seconds . You also see auras of completed Generators . "Are you fucking kidding me? No, you’re not fine, you are so completely far from fine right now." — Brooke

Kill Spree.desc: When all Survivors have reached the second Hook Stage and all Generators have been completed, you can kill Survivors. While killing a Survivor, Exit Gate Switches are blocked by The Entity and for 12 / 18 / 20 seconds after. "He’s killing them, one by one by one like cows." — Cat Lady History [ edit ] 10.3.0 10.3.0 PTB Icon Description When all Survivors have reached the second Hook Stage and all Generators have been completed, you can kill Survivors. While killing a Survivor, Exit Gate Switches are blocked by The Entity and for 12 / 18 / 20 seconds after. Icon Description When all Survivors have reached the second Hook Stage and all Generators have been completed, you can kill Survivors. While killing a Survivor, Exit Gate Switches are blocked by The Entity and for 6 / 9 / 10 seconds after.

Funny Business.desc: Damaging a Generator grants +10 % Haste Status Effect for 10 seconds and triggers one random effect: Retain the Haste effect for 5 seconds longer. Get stunned for 2 seconds . Block the Generator for 30 seconds . The Generator spews out confetti! But nothing actually happens. The same effect cannot happen twice in a row This perk then goes on a 60 / 50 / 40 seconds cool-down. "Glass, insects, and razor blades—there's no telling what you might find." — Clown Cafe Announcer Trivia [ edit ] The perk and its icon mimic Dramaturgy

Valkyrie's Rage.desc: Valkyrie's Rage activates after being chased for 40 / 35 / 30 seconds : The next time you Pallet -stun the Killer, they are stunned for +75 % longer. Valkyrie's Rage then deactivates. "I hope that hurt, fucker!" — Sienna Shaw

Shared Trauma.desc: Taking a protection hit causes you and all Survivors within 12 metres to recover from Exhausted while running for 30 / 35 / 40 seconds . You also see auras of Survivors suffering from Exhausted within 32 metres . "What? I like her scars. I think they're cool." — Gabbie Shaw

Best Gift Ever.desc: Best Gift Ever starts the Trial with 4 / 5 / 6 Tokens : The first time you drop an Item of each type, spend 1 Token to cause the dropped to be consumed by The Entity and benefit from an effect based on the Item: Flashlights : stunning the Killer causes them to be blinded for 2 seconds . Fog Vials : fast-vaulting causes your Scratch Marks to disappear +50 % faster for 5 seconds . Keys : you can rummage each Chest once. Maps : you see auras that last for a duration for +1 second longer. Med-Kits : healing a Survivor causes you to gain healing progress at 25 % speed. Toolboxes : you see auras of the 3 closest Generators . "If a demon enters this world in the flesh, a counterpoint must be appointed to stop it from becoming too powerful." — Jonathan Shaw
